items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: the bandmaster (Professor Jeff) formed a harmonica band... we learned to read on harmonica

ctx.x: You hadn't mentioned that when you talked about your instruments.

Oh, yeah. Well the bandmaster (Professor Jeff) formed a harmonica band. And you know harmonicas have numbers on it and we learned to read on harmonica. And we were going to give a little concert in the auditorium. The day of the concert, someone stole my harmonica. (Laughter). Or I mislaid it, I don't know what happened. I was in the wings while they were out on the stage playing. And the ham that was in me, they started playing 'Turkey in the Straw' and I strutted across the stage doing like a turkey.…
I had to be in the show. (Laughter).
